title: rhamnus alpina subsp. pumila
intro: Rhamnus alpina subsp. pumila, commonly known as the Alpine Buckthorn or Dwarf Buckthorn, is a small shrub or deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, diarrhea, and skin issues. The therapeutic actions of Rhamnus alpina subsp. pumila include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the skin and mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of Rhamnus alpina subsp. pumila include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
